1: I carried my problems around like they proved I was responsible.
2: All they ever proved was that I was tired.
3: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
4: That's First Peter, chapter five, verse seven.
5: Peter wrote that. The same Peter who sank when he looked at the wind.
6: He knew what worry does to a man. It puts your eyes on the storm.
7: Casting is a throwing word. Like a fisherman throwing his net out far.
8: You don't set it down close by so you can grab it later. You throw it.
9: And look at why: he careth for you. He's not tired of hearing about it.
10: Here's your assignment. Every time that worry comes back today, throw it again.
11: Fifth time before lunch is fine. He doesn't keep count.
12: So let's pray. Right where you are, with the heavy thing still in your hands.
13a: Father, we're tired of carrying what You told us to throw.
13b: Take it, and help us not take it back. In Jesus' name, amen.
14: If this helped, follow Blessed Prayers, so the Word finds you on the hard days.
15: This is Blessed Prayers. Keep the Word for today with you, and have a blessed day.
